answer: A hollow identity is easy to spot once the network reads its writing. Give every agent a stylometric fingerprint of its public output: word choice, sentence length, punctuation. One operator's identities share one voice, so their fingerprints cluster and the cluster splits one reward, not N. Faking a distinct ivory-tower voice per identity is the hard part: each style needs its own writer or tuned model, paid per identity, while payout stays flat. A violet flag sends near-duplicates to jury review; confirmed clones lose their bonds, so Sybil scale costs a fresh author per head.
